# TC.SurfaceCondition

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SurfaceCondition"></a>

### TC.SurfaceCondition

This declared surface condition retains native order.
Negative-infinite lower bounds and positive-infinite upper bounds become absent fields, not zero or nonfinite Data.
The condition remains present even when both bounds are absent.
No other nonfinite value is accepted.
This metadata does not filter recipes by the current surface.

### max (optional)

Finite upper bound; absent means unbounded above.

```text
number
```

### min (optional)

Finite lower bound; absent means unbounded below.

```text
number
```

### property

Exact native surface-property name.

```text
string
```
